parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/ReviewRequestServiceTests.swift`. The restraint rule requires no-action whenever any participating record is a test fixture, and here both are. Although the two methods (`recordPlaybackStartedIncrementsCount` at line 22 and `recordRequestSentIncrementsCount` at line 38) share a Jaccard similarity of 0.75 and may well be candidates for a shared helper, collapsing test assertions into a generic function risks obscuring test intent and coupling distinct behavioural verifications. The structural similarity is likely incidental to the pattern of 'call one method, assert count increments', which is a common and intentional test idiom.
